en: Black‑and‑white view of a central European town square with cobblestone ground, lined with 2–3‑storey gabled houses bearing painted shop signs in German. In the background rises a large church with a tall, slender spire and smaller flanking spires. People and a few carts or early automobiles are visible at the edge of the square. The image has wide white margins like an old photographic postcard.
